description: This file defines the 'DefaultHttpConfig' class, which implements the 'HttpConfig' interface. It provides configuration settings related to HTTP, such as hostname, port, and shutdown timeout, and includes methods for creating instances from a configuration object, as well as standard object methods like equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: DefaultHttpConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing HttpConfig, encapsulating HTTP configuration parameters such as hostname, port, and shutdown timeout.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultHttpConfig from a Config object; throws DittoConfigError if configuration is invalid.

methods.name: getHostname
methods.description: Returns the hostname for HTTP configuration.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number for HTTP configuration.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on hostname, port, and shutdown timeout.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on hostname, port, and shutdown timeout.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the configuration object.
